svg.title: Model editing: change one fact, protect the rest
svg.desc: Model editing changes a targeted fact without retraining. KnowledgeEditor predicts a parameter update under a KL locality constraint, ROME writes a rank-one association into a mid-layer MLP, and IKE places the new fact in the prompt. Evaluate efficacy, generalization, and locality.

g.text: Model editing: change one fact, protect the rest
A good edit is efficacious, generalizes to paraphrases, and preserves unrelated behavior.
EDIT THE FACT · CHOOSE A WRITE MECHANISM
“CEO of X is old value” → “CEO of X is new value”
KnowledgeEditor constrains unrelated behavior with KL.
ROME writes a key → value association.
